title: Albert J. Weatherhead, Jr. Professor of Business Administration, Emeritus
bio: Overview John's research focuses on behavioral decision theory, which studies all the ways in which people systematically deviate from rational decision making. To date, his work has looked at the ways in which people irrationally respond to pricing, to product portfolios, and to the adoption of innovative new products. Keywords: Marketing

He joined the HBS Marketing Unit in 1995 after receiving his Ph.D. at the University of Chicago in marketing and behavioral research.
